detail.title: CP-UNC-VC61L5C-VMD-LQ
features: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG
WDR(120dB), Day/Night(ICR), 3D NR, ROI, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC, Digital  watermarking
IR Range of 50 Mtr., Warm Light Range of 30 Mtr.
Micro SD Card, PoE, IP67, IK10

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.001 lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0001 lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux (IR on)
General.White Balance: Auto, Natural, Street lamp, Outdoor, Manual, Regional custom
General.DORI Distance: Lens 3.6 mm: 85.4 m (Detect), 34.2 m (Observe), 17.1 m (Recognize), 8.5 m (Identify);                Lens 2.8 mm: 61.2 m (Detect), 24.5 m (Observe), 12.2 m (Recognize), 6.1 m (Identify)
General.Video Compression: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG (Only supported by sub stream)
General.Frame Rate: Main stream: 6MP (3288 × 1850)@20 fps, 4MP (2688 × 1520)@25/30 fps; Sub Stream 1: D1@25fps,       Sub Stream 2: D1@25fps,       Sub Stream 3:D1@1fps
General.Smart search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine  intelligent search, event extraction and  merging to event videos
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire (the two functions support the classification and accurate detection of   vehicle and human)
General.Protocol: SFTP, IPv6, IPv4, DNS, RTCP, NTP, RTP, RTMP, HTTP, HTTPS, SNMP V3, TLS Version 1.2, TCP/ IP, PPPoE, NFS, UDP, ICMP, SSL, DHCP, SMTP, RTSPS, InstaOn, ONVIF (Profile S, Profile G,  Profile T), unicast, multicast
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, trusted execution, Digest, security logs,  WSSE, account lockout, syslog, video encryption, IP/MAC filtering, HTTPS, trusted upgrade,  trusted boot
General.Alarm Event: No SD card, SD card full, SD card error, Network disconnection, IP conflict, illegal access,        Motion detection, Video tampering, Tripwire, Intrusion, Audio detection, Voltage detection,  IMD (Intelligent motion detection), Security exception
General.Bit Rate: H.265: 3 kbps–8192 kbps, H.264: 3 kbps–8192 kbps
General.Certificates: ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, CE, FCC and RoHS, BIS, STQC approved compliance report
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 2.2 W (12 VDC), 2.9 W (PoE);       Max.: 6.8 W (12 VDC), 8.2 W (PoE) (H.265 + intelligence on+ WDR + illuminator intensity)
